responsibility: Provides the autogenerated documentation URL mapping for Alpha target options declared in alpha.opt. GCC’s option-description machinery reads this companion table to attach manual anchor suffixes for Alpha-specific -m switches such as floating-point mode controls, code-model choices, CPU/tuning selectors, and memory-latency settings, so diagnostics, --help output, or generated option metadata can point back to the correct section of the GCC manual without affecting option semantics or backend code generation.
